# @surfaces-ui/datasource-duckdb-wasm

A DataSource that runs DuckDB in the browser (WebAssembly): real SQL over Parquet with no server.

A `DataSource` that runs DuckDB in the browser: real SQL over Parquet with no server.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/datasource-duckdb-wasm @duckdb/duckdb-wasm
```

`@duckdb/duckdb-wasm` is a peer dependency: your app provides it.

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
